A little introduction

Room for play.
And a little wonder.

Oyri Games is an independent game studio. We build worlds that are easy to step into and rewarding to explore. Sometimes inside a work of art. Sometimes on the other side of the map.

Meet our games
Different worlds.
The same love of play.

How we think about play

Good games start
with a little spark.

Come in curious.

Where is that country? What’s under the next layer of a painting? Our games turn a simple question into a world worth exploring.

Find your own way.

Think through the right sequence or put a guess on the map. We want small decisions to give your time in the game meaning.

Leave with a discovery.

A new artwork in your collection. Another stamp in your passport. Something small to take away from your time at play.
